# Zork II three-headed-dog transcript (#41, spec §3.3).
# Game: zork2 (Release 63 / Serial number 860811)   Seed: 1
# Replay: go run ./internal/actions/capture zork2 1 < zork2-cerberus.txt
# The zork2-walkthrough.txt fixture verbatim up to the descent into the
# Cerberus Room, then a tail that exercises the unleashed dog's state window
# the walkthrough never triggers (it collars the dog on arrival): a blocked
# exit past the dog (hostile), leaving the room (hostility is room-bound —
# the window closes), returning, poking the dog (hostile again), an attack
# the dog survives under this seed, the collar (pacification), and the walk
# east into the Crypt Anteroom that the collar unlocks. Pinned turn-by-turn
# by internal/actions/cerberus_test.go. Test-only: not a calibration fixture
# (fixtures.go / spec §6.1), so it must never join actions.Fixtures.
